newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $114/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $114/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said. Steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher.
Dressed Basis Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1325 lbs 114.00. Dressed Basis Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 114.00.
Slaughter steers and heifers not established on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand continues fairly good. Seller interest mixed.
Sales confirmed: 700 For the week: None.
